The aim of this study was to define the roles of PPARγ in AGEs-induced inflammatory response in human chondrocytes. METHODS Primary human chondrocytes were stimulated with AGEs in the presence or absence of neutralizing antibody against RAGE (anti-RAGE), MAPK specific inhibitors and PPARγ agonist pioglitazone.
